item.title: Now that we have ai recomps, should devs recomp old games they lost the data for?
item.author: invalid@example.com (kakteen)
item.dc:creator: kakteen
item.content:encoded: So now that AI can recompile games (or at least rebuild the game from scratch), would you like if devs use it to recompile their lost games? E.g. square lost a lot of game code (kh1, ffx, fft) and games like parasite eve, are basically only on ps plattforms, because they emulate it. So why don't they use it to recompile their lost data and maybe remaster or port it to other consoles? I do think that older ps1 jrpg's only need a good working crt filter and not high res backgrounds.

item.title: The “Pokemon All-22” trend on social media suggests there’s a huge opportunity available for the franchise
item.author: invalid@example.com (DinoBlaster)
item.dc:creator: DinoBlaster
item.content:encoded: For those of you that haven't seen this trend, it's basically people picking their offensive and defensive lineups for american football using Pokemon. Snorlax at DT, Alakazam at QB, Scyther at DB, etc. I'm kind of surprised Pokemon has never released an arcade sports game. There's plenty of inspiration available like NBA Street or Backyard Baseball, and it seems like people would flock to it in droves. Would there be too much overlap with the Mario sports games? Would you play it?
